backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining data types (CommentList, AppEvent, ChatMessage, ImageMeta, Settings) and CRUD operations for a comment/event management app, including access key management, image storage, chat messages, and export functionality.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that upgrades the actor's stable state from OldActor (Settings without accessKey) to NewActor (Settings with accessKey defaulting to null).
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (access key management, bulk comment generator, append symbol in AI templates) to their source files, components, and test IDs with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a quick reference for the purpose and key functionality of each module.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens (background, foreground, primary, chart colors, sidebar, etc.).
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell titled 'App Content & Feedback Manager' that mounts the React app at the #root div and loads the main TSX entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component providing the app shell with a sticky header (logo, countdown timer, background music toggle), User View / Admin tab navigation, and background music management via a custom hook.
frontend/src/components/AdminUnlock.tsx: Admin authentication gate component that renders a 4-digit PIN input form and calls the useAdminAuth hook to unlock the admin panel.
frontend/src/components/TopDownShooter.t: A React canvas-based top-down shooter game component where the player moves with WASD/arrow keys, shoots by clicking, and must survive waves of spawning enemies with score and time tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAuth.ts: Custom hook managing admin authentication via a hardcoded PIN code, persisting unlock state in sessionStorage with unlock/lock helpers and error state.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackgroundMusic.ts: Custom hook that manages looping background audio playback, toggling play/pause based on a provided URL and enabled flag, and exposing play/pause controls.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommentGenerator.t: Custom hook providing functions to generate single or bulk random comment strings by picking from a CommentList's templates and optionally appending a suffix or symbol.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountdown.ts: Custom hook that returns a live countdown (hours, minutes, seconds) to the next midnight, updating every second via setInterval.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context provider and hook using DFINITY's AuthClient, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and delegation validity checks.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data including comment lists, app events, chat messages, images, and settings via the ICP actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing Inter and Space Grotesk fonts, defining Tailwind CSS layers with a dark OKLCH-based design system including neon/glass utility classes and custom scrollbar styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider into the DOM root.
frontend/src/utils/templateGenerator.ts: Provides a `generateTemplates` utility that produces randomized review-style text strings based on tone (positive/neutral/critical), category (performance/ui/features/support), and length (short/medium/long) using predefined phrase banks.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminAITemplate: An admin view for generating comment templates locally based on a topic, tone, and count using predefined phrase patterns, with options to select and bulk-add generated templates to a comment list.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminChat.tsx: An admin chat panel that displays stored chat messages with auto-refresh and allows sending new messages, rendering them in a scrollable list with timestamps.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminComments.t: Admin panel tab for managing comment lists: create new lists, add template lines to a selected list, and toggle list lock state with live overview of all lists.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminImages.tsx: Admin panel tab for uploading images with a name, tags, file picker, and upload progress bar, using the ExternalBlob API to stream bytes to the backend.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminLiveList.t: Admin panel tab for managing live app/event lists: add, rename, delete apps/events, and bulk-add usernames to a selected entry.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminSettings.t: Admin panel tab for global settings: toggle background music, upload a music file with progress tracking, and manage (set/regenerate/view) the access key.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminView.tsx: Top-level admin view that gates access behind AdminUnlock authentication and renders tabbed navigation across Comments, AI Templates, Images, Chat, Live List, and Settings sub-views.
frontend/src/views/LiveChecker.tsx: A view component that lets users enter a username and check its presence across selected apps/events by searching their stored username lists, displaying found/not-found results.
frontend/src/views/UploadView.tsx: A bulk upload view that reads a .txt or .csv file line-by-line and adds the parsed templates to a selected comment list via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/views/UserView.tsx: A user-facing bulk comment generator that validates an access key, filters comment lists by selected app/event, generates a specified quantity of comments, and supports copying individual or all comments to the clipboard.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts, oklch-based color tokens (neon, sidebar, chart), border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations including neon pulse and fade-in.
project_state.json: Tracks the overall project state (version 5) for the App Content & Feedback Manager, including architectural notes, known issues, and a full list of existing features with their IDs, titles, requirement references, and versions.
